title: 第二十三章安平城第二十四章元婴
slug: 扫地八十年从宗门杂役飞升成仙
lines: 叶凡跑了大半个时辰，绕出林道，脚下的土路渐渐变宽，从夯实的黄土变成铺了青石的官道。
人也多了起来。
挑担的，赶车的，背着包袱赶路的。
三三两两，从他身边过去，谁也没多看他一眼。
叶凡放慢脚步，把那股窜出去的劲儿收住，重新做回那个缩着肩膀的锻体四阶。
官道尽头，一座城轮廓慢慢清晰。
叶凡抬头看了一眼，脚步顿住。
“这是……安平城？”
他站在原地，盯着前方那道城墙，半天没动。
城墙高得离谱，青灰色的砖石垒上去，少说也有七八丈。
墙头上插着旗，旗下站着披甲的兵卒，手里的长矛在日头底下泛光。
城门洞大开，进出的车马排成长队，吆喝声、马蹄声、车轮碾石的动静，隔着老远就灌进耳朵。
叶凡咽了口唾沫。
他不是没见过城。八十年前他来天剑宗拜师，就是从这条道走的，路过的也是安平城。
可那会儿的安平城，是个什么样子？
满打满算几千号人。
一圈矮土墙，墙皮都掉得差不多了，城门是两扇破木板，晚上拿根木头一顶就算关了。
城里就一条主街，铺子稀稀拉拉，卖菜的卖布的，赶上集市才热闹一阵。
那哪是城。
那就是个稍微大点的镇子。
叶凡当年还在城东一个算命摊子边上歇过脚，李瞎子给他算了一卦，说他此去有大造化。结果造化没见着，倒在杂役峰扫了八十年地。
“好家伙。”叶凡摸了摸下巴，往前走了几步，又停下。
眼前这座城，跟记忆里那个破镇子，根本搭不上边。
光是城门口排队的人，怕是就比当年全城的人都多。
他顺着人流往城门挪，越靠近，越觉得不对劲。
城外不光有凡人。
队伍里夹着几个穿青衫的，腰里挂着剑，脚步轻飘飘的，一看就是练气的散修。
还有一队人马护着辆华贵马车，车帘掀开一角，里头坐着的人手腕上套着一圈灵气流转的玉镯，那是家族修士的派头。
叶凡眯了眯眼。
天剑宗的弟子他也认得出几个。城门口那边就站着两个，穿着外门青衣，袖口绣着交叉小剑，正叉着腰跟守城兵卒说话，神气得很。
他心里头犯起嘀咕。
天剑宗在他印象里，算不得什么大宗门。
整个修仙界的格局他了解得不多，但杂役峰待了八十年，多少听过些闲话。
天剑宗也就是个三流货色，靠着剑修传承勉强立足，元婴老祖统共没几个，弟子加起来撑死几千。
这么个三流宗门，山脚下的附庸城，凭啥能繁华成这样？
数十万人口的大城，比凡尘里的京城还热闹。
叶凡想不明白。
他在城门口站了会儿，看着那队伍一点点往里挪，忽然觉得自己这八十年活得有点亏。
人家这世道都翻天覆地了，他还在废丹洞里跟一堆烂丹药较劲。
“行了行了。”叶凡甩了甩头，把那点感慨压下去。
想这些没用。
眼下他下山就两件事。一是抓鸡，二是淘换废旧法器。安平城既然是必经之地，那就先进去把路子摸清楚。
至于这城为啥这么阔气，进去打听打听不就知道了。
他低着头，跟着人流往城门走。
守城的兵卒拦了他一下，眼睛扫到他腰间那块天剑宗令牌，态度立马软了三分，挥手就放行。
content_en:
Ye Fan ran for more than half an hour, detouring out of the forest road. The dirt road under his feet gradually widened, changing from compacted loess to an official road paved with bluestones.
There are also more people.
Those who carry burdens, those who drive carts, those who carry burdens on their way.
They passed by him in twos and threes, and no one glanced at him.
Ye Fan slowed down, held back the energy that was escaping, and returned to the fourth level of physical training with his shoulders shrunk.
At the end of the official road, the outline of a city gradually became clear.
Ye Fan looked up and paused.
"This is... Anping City?"
He stood there, staring at the city wall in front of him, without moving for a long time.
The city wall is ridiculously high, with blue-gray masonry built up, at least seven or eight feet long.
There was a flag on the wall, and under the flag stood armored soldiers, the spears in their hands glowing under the sun.
The city gate is wide open, and there are long queues of cars and horses entering and exiting. The sound of shouts, the sound of horse hooves, and the sound of wheels grinding stones can be heard from a long distance.
Ye Fan swallowed.
It's not like he hasn't seen the city before. Eighty years ago, he came to Tianjian Sect to become a disciple. He took this road and passed by Anping City.
But what was Anping City like at that time?
There are thousands of people in total.
There is a circle of low earthen walls, the wall covering is almost peeled off, and the city gate is made of two broken wooden doors. At night, just use a piece of wood to push them against each other and it will be closed.
There is only one main street in the city, with only a few shops and vegetable sellers and cloth sellers. It only becomes lively when the market comes.
Then where is the city?
That's a slightly bigger town.
Back then, Ye Fan rested at a fortune-telling stall in the east of the city. Blind Man Li gave him a fortune-telling and said that he would have great fortunes there. As a result, the creation was not seen, and he fell to the ground where he had been sweeping for eighty years on the Miscellaneous Peak.
"Good guy." Ye Fan touched his chin, took a few steps forward, and then stopped.
The city in front of me is nothing like the shabby town in my memory.
There were probably more people queuing up at the city gate than there were in the whole city back then.
He followed the flow of people towards the city gate. The closer he got, the more he felt something was wrong.
There are not just mortals outside the city.
There were several people in the team wearing green shirts, with swords hanging on their waists, and light steps. They looked like casual cultivators practicing Qi.
There is also a team of people guarding a luxurious carriage. The curtain of the carriage is opened at a corner, and the person sitting inside wears a jade bracelet with spiritual energy flowing around his wrist, which is the style of the family monks.
Ye Fan narrowed his eyes.
He also recognized a few disciples of Tianjian Sect. There were two people standing at the gate of the city. They were wearing green outer robes with crossed swords embroidered on their cuffs. They were talking to the soldiers guarding the city with their arms akimbo, looking very proud.
He murmured in his mind.
In his impression, Tianjian Sect was not a big sect.
He didn't know much about the overall structure of the world of immortality, but he had been in Zaoyufeng for eighty years and had heard some gossip.
The Tianjian Sect is just a third-rate thing, barely able to survive by relying on the inheritance of sword cultivation. There are only a few Yuan Ying ancestors, and the total number of disciples can support thousands.
How could such a third-rate sect and a vassal city at the foot of the mountain be so prosperous?
A big city with a population of hundreds of thousands is more lively than the capital city in the mortal world.
Ye Fan couldn't understand.
He stood at the city gate for a while, watching the team move in little by little, and suddenly felt that his eighty years of life had been a bit of a loss.
The world has been turned upside down, and he is still fighting with a bunch of bad pills in the Waste Pill Cave.
"Okay, okay." Ye Fan shook his head and suppressed the emotion.
It's no use thinking about this.
There are two things he wants to do when he comes down the mountain right now. One is to catch chickens, and the other is to search for and replace old magical instruments. Since Anping City is a must-pass, let’s go in first and find out the way.
As for why this city is so wealthy, you will know if you go in and ask around.
He lowered his head and followed the crowd towards the city gate.
The soldiers guarding the city stopped him, glanced at the Tianjian Sect token on his waist, and immediately softened their attitude, waving their hands and letting him go.
